name: lead-intake-brief-generator
display_name: Consult Prep & Lead Triage Brief Generator
description: One skill: /lead-intake-brief. Provide intake notes, an email thread, or uploaded documents; the skill drafts a one-page brief — parties, dates, matter-type suggestion, urgency flag, open questions, recommended next step — strictly from what's supplied. Assisted draft, always reviewed — never accepts, declines, routes, or assigns a lead, never runs a conflict check, never invents a fact, never computes a deadline.
